mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CompanyID FROM ${systemDatabase}.tbAllUserList WHERE account=#{account}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${systemDatabase}.tbAllUserList (CompanyID,account,createTime) VALUES (#{data.companyId},#{data.account},#{data.createtime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CompanyID=VALUES(CompanyID)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${systemDatabase}.tbAllUserList WHERE CompanyID=#{companyId} AND account=#{account}
